nodes.summary: The `0/1` count of the `'1'` allele carried by a gamete at one locus.
nodes.title: Allele count of a gamete at one locus

nodes.summary: Local-ancestry covariance in Morgans: `Cov(I_x, I_y) = α (1 - α) e^{-n d} (cosh d)^n` for loci `d` Morgans apart.
nodes.title: Local-ancestry covariance in Morgans

nodes.summary: Pulse admixture: after `n` generations of random mating the local-ancestry indicators at two loci with recombination fraction `r` have covariance `Cov(I_x, I_y) = α (1 - α) (1 - r)^n` (for every real `α`, `r`; the biological domain is `0 ≤ α ≤ 1`, `0 ≤ r ≤ 1/2`). The ancestry labels obey the two-locus random-mating recursion of `Linkage.recombine` (Chakraborty and Weiss 1988).
nodes.title: Covariance of local-ancestry indicators after pulse admixture

nodes.summary: The covariance of the allele counts of one gamete is the linkage disequilibrium `D = x_AB x_ab - x_Ab x_aB` (frequencies summing to `1`).
nodes.title: Gamete allele covariance equals linkage disequilibrium

nodes.summary: The covariance of the allele counts at the two loci of one gamete drawn from the gamete frequencies `x`: `∑ g, x g a(g.1) a(g.2) - (∑ g, x g a(g.1)) (∑ g, x g a(g.2))`.
nodes.title: Covariance of allele counts within a gamete

nodes.summary: Joint law of the local-ancestry labels at the two loci right after the pulse (`true` = descends from `A`): every gamete is entirely from `A` (probability `α`) or entirely from `B`. This is `sourceMix` with perfectly differentiated markers (`pA = qA = 1`, `pB = qB = 0`).
nodes.title: Joint law of local ancestry after an admixture pulse

nodes.summary: The frequency `p` of the `'1'` allele (`b = true`) or `1 - p` of the `'0'` allele.
nodes.title: Bernoulli allele frequency

nodes.summary: The continuous decay `e^{-n d}` used by Chakraborty and Weiss (1988) and Loh et al. (2013) is a lower bound for the exact factor `(1 - r)^n` under Haldane's map (all real `d`; the biological domain is `0 ≤ d`).
nodes.title: Continuous decay is a lower bound for the exact factor under Haldane's map

nodes.summary: Branch points on the `A–B` path. Suppose that `A = A″ + uA`, `A′ = A″ + uA'`, `B = B″ + uB`, `B′ = B″ + uB'` at the level of lineage weights, where `w A″ - w B″` is disjoint in support from each of `uA`, `uB`, `uA'`, `uB'`, and each of `uA`, `uB` is disjoint from each of `uA'`, `uB'`. On a tree this says that the paths `A″–B″`, `A″–A`, `B″–B`, `A″–A′`, `B″–B′` share no edge (the vectors may be signed, so every…
nodes.title: f4 equals f2 for references branching off the path

nodes.summary: The diploid genotype covariance in the admixed population `n` generations after the pulse: `z(x, y) = 2 α (1 - α) (1 - r)^n δ(x) δ(y)` (Loh et al. 2013, Eq. 3, with the exact discrete-generation factor `(1 - r)^n` in place of `e^{-n d}`).
nodes.title: Diploid genotype covariance in an admixed population

nodes.summary: The diploid genotype covariance is twice the haplotype one, `z = 2 D`: the two same-gamete terms each contribute `D` and the two cross-gamete terms vanish by independence (Loh et al. 2013, Eqs. 2–3).
nodes.title: Diploid genotype covariance is twice the linkage disequilibrium

nodes.summary: The covariance of the unphased diploid genotypes `X = X₁ + X₂ ∈ {0, 1, 2}` at the first locus and `Y = Y₁ + Y₂` at the second, for an individual made of two gametes `g`, `h` drawn independently from `x` (random union of gametes). This is `z(x, y)` of Loh et al. (2013), Eq. 1.
nodes.title: Covariance of unphased diploid genotypes

nodes.summary: Admixture LD after `n` generations of random mating with recombination fraction `r`: `D_n = (1 - r)^n α (1 - α) δ(x) δ(y)`.
nodes.title: Decay of admixture linkage disequilibrium over generations

nodes.summary: Admixture LD right after the pulse: `D₀ = α (1 - α) δ(x) δ(y)`, with `δ(x) = pA - pB`, `δ(y) = qA - qB` (Chakraborty and Weiss 1988).
nodes.title: Admixture linkage disequilibrium right after the pulse

nodes.summary: With Haldane's map function, `1 - r = e^{-d} cosh d` for map length `d`.
nodes.title: Haldane's map function: $1 - r = e^{-d}\cosh d$

nodes.summary: Exact decay in Morgans: `(1 - r)^n = e^{-n d} (cosh d)^n` when `r = haldane d`.
nodes.title: Exact decay factor under Haldane's map function

nodes.summary: Gamete frequencies right after the pulse: with probability `α` the gamete comes from `A`, where the loci are in linkage equilibrium with `'1'` frequencies `pA` and `qA`, and otherwise from `B` (frequencies `pB`, `qB`). The biological domain is `α, pA, qA, pB, qB ∈ [0, 1]`; the identities below hold for all reals.
nodes.title: Gamete frequencies after an admixture pulse

nodes.summary: Recombination keeps gamete frequencies summing to `1` over any number of generations.
nodes.title: Recombination preserves total gamete frequency

nodes.summary: The pulse gamete frequencies sum to `1`.
nodes.title: Pulse gamete frequencies sum to one

nodes.summary: One reference `A` and the admixed population `C` itself, with no drift in `C` after the pulse (`w C = α w A + (1 - α) w B`): the weights are `p A - p C = β δ` and the amplitude is `2 α β^3 F2(A, B)^2` (Loh et al. 2013, Eq. 7).
nodes.title: Weighted LD amplitude with the admixed population as reference

nodes.summary: Two diverged references `A′`, `B′` branching off the `A–B` path at `A″` and `B″`: the amplitude is `2 α β F2(A″, B″)^2` (Loh et al. 2013, Eq. 6).
nodes.title: Weighted LD amplitude with two diverged references

nodes.summary: The expected weighted LD factors as `2 α (1 - α) (1 - r)^n (f4 A B R S)^2`: by independence of the loci, `𝔼[δ(x) w(x) δ(y) w(y)] = 𝔼[δ w]^2` and `𝔼[δ w] = f4 A B R S`. The identity holds with the Bochner-integral conventions as stated; it is meaningful when the frequencies are square integrable, as in every `DriftModel`.
nodes.title: Weighted linkage disequilibrium in terms of the f4 statistic

nodes.summary: One diverged reference `R′` branching off the `A–B` path at `R″` (so `A = R″ + uA`, `B = R″ + uB`, `R′ = R″ + uR` with pairwise disjoint supports) and the admixed population `C` with no post-pulse drift: the weights `p R′ - p C` give the amplitude `2 α β (α F2(A, R″) - β F2(B, R″))^2` (Loh et al. 2013, Eq. 8).
nodes.title: Weighted LD amplitude with one diverged reference

nodes.summary: Weights from the true mixing populations (`R = A`, `S = B`): the amplitude is `2 α β F2(A, B)^2` (Loh et al. 2013, Eq. 4).
nodes.title: Weighted LD amplitude with the true source populations

nodes.summary: The expected ALDER two-site weighted-LD statistic `𝔼[z(x, y) w(x) w(y)]` (Loh et al. 2013, Appendix A, without distance binning). The loci `x` and `y` drift independently: `ω.1` and `ω.2` are independent draws from `μ`, and `p X ω` is the frequency of the `'1'` allele in population `X`. The covariance `z(x, y)` is that of the population formed `n` generations ago as an `α : 1 - α` mixture of `A` and `B`…
nodes.title: Expected ALDER weighted linkage disequilibrium

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
